## 0.2.0-beta.4 (2026-11-13)


### Features

* **diagnostics:** Added a built-in packet capture option to Connect with Diagnostics
* **diagnostics:** Added freeze snapshots and self-describing diagnostic folders
* **displays:** Added manual screen refresh with combined recovery
* **engine:** Updated the bundled FreeRDP engine to 3.33


### Fixes

* **displays:** Fixed the clipped Windows taskbar on a notched MacBook display in fullscreen multimon
* **displays:** Fixed the remote desktop size on the MacBook display after external monitors disconnected
* **displays:** Stopped sending a duplicate display layout after connecting, which ended sessions after about 10 seconds on some Windows hosts with NVIDIA hardware video encoding
* Fixed connection previews flickering on hover
* Fixed display selection in the performance panel during fullscreen sessions
* Fixed performance charts leaving long sessions squeezed at the right edge
* **fullscreen:** Fixed the missing connection bar and visible Dock after re-entering fullscreen
* **reconnect:** Fixed the reconnecting overlay flickering and made the pointer visible while reconnecting

## 0.2.0-beta.3 (2026-10-22)


### Features

* **displays:** Added automatic window size restoration
* **displays:** Use fullscreen mode with recommended DPI scaling as default
* **quick-connect:** Added full configuration for temporary connections
* **updates:** Added in-app updates with Sparkle


### Fixes

* **displays:** Upgraded persisted factory display defaults
